entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-27
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.CognitiveServices_1.8.0-beta.1

1.8.0-beta.1 (2026-11-25)

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version to 2026-11-15-preview.
  • Added management of attached AKS clusters through CognitiveServicesAccountResource.GetAttachedAksClusters, AttachedAksClusterResource, and related status and configuration models.
  • Added CognitiveServicesProjectCostControlResource for project-level cost controls and budget settings for cost or token usage, filters, grouping, notifications, and enforcement actions.
  • Added CognitiveServicesProjectProperties.ToolControls to configure the default tool access policy and explicitly allowed tools.
  • Added RAI ACS intervention points for agent startup and shutdown and before and after model calls, along with new policy targets.
  • Added CognitiveServicesManagedComputeUsage.ScopeId.
  • Added ArcDeploymentModel.AssetId and read-only Version, and a force option for deleting an Arc deployment when its extension is disconnected.

Breaking Changes

  • Changed TargetClusterId from string to ResourceIdentifier in the preview compute and workbench models ContainerInstanceComputeProperties, CognitiveServicesWorkbenchProperties, and CognitiveServicesWorkbenchPatchProperties, including their constructors and model-factory parameters.

Bugs Fixed

  • Aligned new AKS attachment status properties, Foundry agent hosting models, project tool-control models, workbench models, and the AKS attachment deletion disposition with .NET naming conventions.
  • Preserved partial positional model-factory calls supported in 1.7.0 for deployment properties and RAI policy properties.

Azure.ResourceManager.Network_1.18.0

1.18.0 (2026-11-24)

This release ensures no breaking API changes compared with version 1.15.0 only. Versions 1.16.x and 1.17.x have been retracted; compatibility with those versions or previous preview releases is not guaranteed.

Features Added

  • Upgraded the default Network API version from 2026-03-01 to 2026-05-01.
  • Added Application Gateway deployment tiers and confidential compute settings.
  • Added configurable TCP idle timeouts for Azure Firewall.
  • Added network adapter indices for network interfaces.
  • Added load-balancer configuration for network virtual appliances and their inbound security rules, including load distribution and idle timeout settings.

Other Changes

  • Regenerated the library from the updated Network specification.
  • Updated the preview capability API: removed VirtualNetworkApplianceCapabilityBaseData. VirtualNetworkApplianceCapabilityData now derives directly from ResourceData and declares Properties itself.
  • Updated the preview Interconnect Group and Subgroup APIs: flattened properties onto their resource data types and updated the corresponding model factories. The property-envelope types are now internal.
  • Represented the Interconnect Group resource GUID as Guid? instead of string.

Azure.ResourceManager.Chaos_1.2.0-beta.4

1.2.0-beta.4 (2026-11-20)

Features Added

  • Updated the default API version to 2026-11-01.
